label: Explicit-stream compiled mapped gather launch
hypothesis: Mapped launch Python dispatch and stream context cost can be reduced using the same compiled kernel runner with explicit copy-stream handle; isolated b1 submit10.444859 to3.854606us, b8 submit9.845417 to3.711913us. Whole-model benefit remains unproven.
change: Cache the exact compiled mapped-gather runner per ID pointer-alignment specialization after ordinary JIT launch, use explicit copy stream thereafter, preserving device context and all existing entry/consumed/copied/lifetime dependencies. No event reuse, caller-stream gather, callback or generic model changes.
tradeoffs: Compiled runner must match dtype/device/shapes and pointer-alignment specialization; offset IDs need their own compilation key.
Retain CPU-table mutation and GPU-ID lifetime semantics, error cleanup, cross-stream consumption and original synchronization.
Isolated launch saving is not an additive prediction of full-generation speedup; b8 drained kernel cost is unchanged.
Keep A0028 shared-host and earlier mapped/pipeline policies unchanged; no output/token lookup caching.
confirmation_rule: Unchanged complete-screen nomination, exactly3 fresh balanced blocks, fixed Holm family and signed95% regression guards; no optional extension.
